verdicts.reason: A crams every text block into a jumbled stack in the centre-right and leaves the left ~30% of the banner empty. The lines nearly touch, the dashed dividers have collapsed into one stray rule under the green line, the reading order is broken (the green tagline comes before the dashes and the contact lines) and the booking text is illegibly small. B at least reads left to right in columns (headline, body, tagline, contact). But the dashed dividers are broken into odd stacked fragments, the original serif italic seems to have turned into a generic sans (an off-brand change), 'creativity.' and 'equipment!' are left as orphans, and the phone and web text on the right is unreadably tiny.
